changelog: Phone: channel groups. Group channels (e.g. "Music", "Cooking") and see only the latest videos of each group, with play all and shuffle. New "Channel groups" section in More. Add channels from your subscriptions (with search, or by pasting a channel link), from the channel page, from the player (button next to Subscribe) and from the long press menu of any video or channel ("Add to group").

Phone: the groups are the same data SuperTube TV and SmartTube use. Import a SmartTube or SuperTube TV backup (.zip), or a SuperTube, GrayJay, PocketTube or NewPipe file; groups with the same name are merged. Export them to a file that SmartTube and SuperTube TV import as is ("Import (GrayJay/PocketTube/NewPipe)"). The phone backup includes the groups.

Phone: the default video quality fits the screen (1080p60 on most phones) instead of 4K60: the same picture with far less data, and fewer stalls on mobile networks. A lower quality or "Auto" chosen by you is kept.
Phone: the picture froze for about 3 seconds (with the audio going on) on every rotation, and when entering or leaving fullscreen or picture-in-picture.
Phone: a channel opened from a link showed no name or picture, or those of the previous channel.
"Highest" video buffer could use more memory than the app is allowed on phones with lots of RAM (stutters, crashes). Phone and TV.
A video server that stops sending held playback for 20 seconds before retrying (now 8). A background thread was left behind for every video played. Phone and TV.
